Question
========

Betrachten Sie die folgende Zitationsvarianten. Wählen Sie die laut APA V7 korrekte Variante!

```{r defs}

n_variants <- 11

term1_set <- c("Accommodation",
               "Acetylcholine",
               "Achievement motive",
               "Adaptation",
               "Adrenal cortex",
               "Adrenal cortex",
               "Alpha waves",
               "Amygdala",
               "Animism",
               "Availability heuristic",
               "Basilar membrane",
               "Benzodiazepines",
               "Centration",
               "Closure",
               "Closure",
               "Congruence",
               "Conflict",
               "Consolidation",
               "Decentration")
term1 <- sample(term1_set, 1)


term2_set <- c("Delusion",
           "Extravibulatin",
           "Enrichment",
           "Detachment",
           "Vasculation",
           "Durenchment",
           "Corroboration",
           "Dissolution",
           "Descend",
           "Enhancement",
           "Trial Procedure",
           "Diminuishment",
           "Shock Parlance") %>% str_to_lower()
term2 <- sample(term2_set, 1)


term3_set <- c("Priming",
           "Closure",
           "Responsibility",
           "Continuity",
           "Prxomity",
           "Simplicity",
           "Problem solving",
           "Projection",
           "Assigment",
           "Range",
           "Orthogonalization",
           "Recall",
           "Reception",
           "Reciprocal determinism",
           "Reinforcement",
           "Relearning"
           ) %>% str_to_lower()
term3 <- sample(term3_set, 1)


name1_set <-  c("Smith", "Wesson", "Lyderfield", "Gresco", "Wiener", "ODonney", "Shingerfield", "McDunnald", "Shilder", "Weyner", "Ohara")
name1 <- sample(name1_set, 1)

name2_set <- c("Adams", "Jefferson", "Madison", "Monroe", "Adams", "Van Buren", "Tyler", "Harrison", "Polk", "Fillmore", "Pierce")
name2 <- sample(name2_set, 1)

initial1 <- paste0(sample(LETTERS, 1), ".")
initial2 <- paste0(sample(LETTERS, 1), ".")

rnum1 <- runif(1, min = 1, max = 99) %>% floor() %>% as.character()

page1 <- runif(1, min = 1, max = 499) %>% floor() 
page2 <-  {page1 + runif(1, min = 1, max = 20)} %>% floor() %>% as.character()
page1 <- page1 %>% as.character()



```





```{r build-data}
d <- 
  tibble( citation = c("{name1}, {initial1}, & {name2}, {initial2} (1968). {term1} {term2} in emergencies: Diffusion of {term3}. *Journal of Personality and Social Psychology*, *{rnum1}*,  {page1}–{page2}.",
                       "{name1}, {initial1} &  {name2}, {initial2} (1968). {term1} {term2} in emergencies: diffusion of {term3}. *Journal of Personality and Social Psychology*, *{rnum1}*,  {page1}–{page2}.",
                       "{name1}, {initial1}, & {name2}, {initial2} (1968). {term1} {term2} in emergencies: Diffusion of {term3}. Journal of personality and social psychology, {rnum1},  {page1}–{page2}.",
                       "{name1}, {initial1}, & {name2}, {initial2} (1968).{term1} {term2} in Emergencies: Diffusion of {term3}. *Journal of Personality and Social Psychology*, {rnum1}.  {page1}–{page2}.",
                       "{name1}, {initial1}, & {name2}, {initial2} (1968).{term1} {term2} in emergencies: Diffusion of {term3}. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, *{rnum1}*.  {page1}–{page2}.",
                       "{name1}, {initial1} &  {name2}, {initial2} (1968).{term1} {term2} in emergencies: Diffusion of {term3}. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, {rnum1}.  {page1}–{page2}.",
                       "{name1}, {initial1}, and {name2}, {initial2} (1968).{term1} {term2} in emergencies: Diffusion of {term3}. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, {rnum1},  {page1}–{page2}.",
                       "{name1}, {initial1}, & {name2}, {initial2}, 1968. {term1} {term2} in emergencies: Diffusion of {term3}. *Journal of Personality and Social Psychology*, *{rnum1}*,  {page1}–{page2}.",
                       "{name1}, {initial1}, & {name2}, {initial2} (1968). {term1} {term2} in emergencies: Diffusion of {term3}. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, *{rnum1}*,  {page1}–{page2}.",
                       "{name1}, {initial1} &  {name2}, {initial2} (1968). {term1} {term2} in emergencies: Diffusion of {term3}. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, {rnum1},  {page1}–{page2}.",
                       "{name1}, {initial1}, & {name2}, {initial2}, 1968, {term1} {term2} in emergencies: Diffusion of {term3}. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, *{rnum1}*,  {page1}–{page2}.")) %>% 
  mutate(
        is_correct = c(TRUE,FALSE,FALSE,FALSE,
                       FALSE,FALSE,FALSE,FALSE,FALSE,FALSE,FALSE)) 


citation2 <-
  str_replace(d$citation, pattern = "\\{name1\\}",
              replacement = name1) %>% 
  str_replace("\\{initial1\\}", initial1) %>% 
  str_replace( "\\{name2\\}", name2) %>% 
  str_replace( "\\{initial2\\}", initial2) %>%   
  str_replace( "\\{term1\\}", term1) %>% 
  str_replace( "\\{term2\\}", term2) %>% 
  str_replace( "\\{term3\\}", term3) %>% 
  str_replace( "\\{rnum1\\}", rnum1) %>% 
  str_replace( "\\{page1\\}", page1) %>% 
  str_replace("\\{page2\\}", page2)



d <-
  d %>% 
  mutate(citation_parsed = citation2) %>% 
  group_by(is_correct) %>% 
  mutate(id = row_number()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(is_correct==TRUE | (is_correct==FALSE & between(id, 1, 4))) 
```



```{r itemlist, results='asis'}
answerlist(d$citation_parsed, markup = "markdown")
```






Solution
========


Die richtige Zitation ist "`r d$citation_parsed[d$is_correct == TRUE]`".




```{r answerlist, results='asis'}
answerlist(ifelse(d$is_correct, "Wahr", "Falsch"), markup = "markdown")
```
